say:0:1120754001:0.text: Chak and Rumon are running there so fast! They must be happy!
say:0:1120754001:0.source_cn: 奇克他们跑得真快，看来真的很开心呢。

say:1:1120754002:0.text: But even though Chak is very skilled, fighting ironjaws is no small task...
say:1:1120754002:0.source_cn: 不过，虽然他滑沙的技术很厉害，斗兽毕竟是另一回事……

say:2:1120754003:0.text: Magister, Chippy is also worried... Chippy doesn't want him to get hurt!
say:2:1120754003:0.source_cn: 主人，我也有点担心……万一他在训练的时候受伤就不好了！
say:2:1120754003:0.male: Magister, Chippy is also worried... Chippy doesn't want him to get hurt!
say:2:1120754003:0.female: Magister, Chippy is also worried... Chippy doesn't want him to get hurt!

say:3:1120754004:0.text: When we have time, let's see how the training is going.
say:3:1120754004:0.source_cn: 等有空闲的时候，我们一起去看看他们的训练情况吧。
say:3:1120754004:0.male: When we have time, let's see how the training is going.
say:3:1120754004:0.female: When we have time, let's see how the training is going.
